description: For a serial relation and a prescribed starting point, the singleton starting history is valid and every valid finite relation history has a valid one-term extension.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.relation_histories_serial.{u} {α : Type u} (R : α → α → Prop)
  (hR : Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.Serial R) (x₀ : α) :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.RelationHistory R x₀ [x₀] ∧
    ∀ (s : List α),
      Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.RelationHistory R x₀ s →
        ∃ t,
          Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.RelationHistory R x₀ t ∧
            Lemmatheca.SetTheory.WeakerChoice.OneTermExtension s t
